# The routes of the reference panel (v1.15.2) that Raptor serves, written from reference/routes/*.php. A parameter is {} and a
# catch-all is *. "MISSING" lines are not routes: they name what is left out on purpose, see docs/plan.md chapter 6.5.

# routes/base.php
GET /
GET /account
GET /locales/locale.json
GET /*

# routes/auth.php
GET /auth/login
GET /auth/password
GET /auth/password/reset/{}
GET /auth/*
POST /auth/login
POST /auth/login/checkpoint
POST /auth/password
POST /auth/password/reset
POST /auth/logout

# Laravel Sanctum's own route, which the frontend calls before it signs in.
GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie
